ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the graph of f is a broken line, rising from (0,0) to about (1,2), then falling to (2,0), then continuing to fall to about (3,-3), and finally rising back to (4,0). Therefore, when 0<x<2, f is above the x-axis; at x=2 it crosses the x-axis; when 2<x<4, f is below the x-axis; at x=4 it returns to the x-axis. Reasoning: From g(x)=∫_0^x f(t)dt and the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, it is known that g'(x)=f(x). So when f(x)>0, g increases; when f(x)<0, g decreases. Thus g increases on (0,2) and decreases on (2,4). Since by x=4 this segment of decrease ends, among positive x values the minimum value of g occurs at x=4.

method.method_draft: Read the graph of f from the image: f is above the x-axis for 0<x<2, crosses the x-axis at x=2, is below the x-axis for 2<x<4, and returns to the x-axis at x=4. Since g increases on (0,2) and decreases on (2,4), the minimum among positive x shown occurs at the endpoint after the decreasing interval, x=4.

method.method_draft: Read the key points of the piecewise-linear graph from the image: approximately (0,0), (1,2), (2,0), (3,-3), and (4,0). From the text, g(x) is the accumulated signed area under f from 0 to x. Compute the accumulated areas at the relevant breakpoints: from 0 to 2 the area is a positive triangle with base 2 and height 2, so area 2; from 2 to 4 the area is a negative triangle with base 2 and height 3, so area -3. Thus g(0)=0, g(2)=2, and g(4)=2-3=-1. Since the graph is linear between these points, the accumulated area reaches its smallest shown value at x=4.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是函数 f 的折线图。折线依次经过约 (0,0)、(1,2)、(2,0)、(3,-3)、(4,0)。在 0 到 2 之间，图像在 x 轴上方；在 2 到 4 之间，图像在 x 轴下方。

推理：g(x)=∫_0^x f(t)dt 表示从 0 到 x 的有符号面积。0 到 2 的面积是一个正三角形，底为 2，高为 2，面积为 2，所以 g(2)=2。2 到 4 的面积是一个负三角形，底为 2，高为 3，面积为 -3，所以 g(4)=2-3=-1。由于 g'(x)=f(x)，g 在 f>0 时增加，在 f<0 时减少，因此从 x=2 到 x=4 一直减少，并在 x=4 达到最小值。
